description: This file contains the PHP class 'GeoZone' within the Opencart	oSystem	oEngine	oModel namespace, which manages geographical zone data for the Opencart e-commerce system. It includes methods to retrieve geo zone data from the database.

classes.name: GeoZone
classes.description: A class for interacting with geographical zone data, providing methods to retrieve specific geo zones and lists of geo zones.

methods.name: getGeoZone
methods.description: Retrieves a specific geographical zone based on geo_zone_id, country_id, and zone_id.

methods.name: getGeoZones
methods.description: Retrieves a list of all geographical zones.
